spans.s: शुच् (I) vt. 1P (pres. शोचति) 1. To bewail, to grieve for, to be sorry, मा शुचः संपदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पांडव Bg.xvi.5, Bt.xv.71; 2. to regret, to repent.With अनु-, to bewail, अशोच्यानन्वशोचस्त्वं प्रज्ञावादांश्च भाषते । गतासूनगतासूंश्च नानुशोचंति पंडिताः Bg.ii.11.With परि-, to bewail.
शुच् (II) vi. 4U (pres. शुच्यति-ते) 1. To be afflicted; 2. to be wet.
शुच् f. Sorrow, grief, distress, प्रमदामनु संस्थितः शुचा नृपतिः सन्निति वाच्यदर्शनात् R.viii.72, मम विरहजां न त्वं वत्से शुचं गणयिष्यसि Sak.iv., R.xii.75.

सूच् vt. 10U (pres. सूचयति-ते) 1. To pierce; 2. to point out, to indicate, to show, to prove, to manifest, to suggest, सारंगास्ते जललवमुचः सूचयिष्यंति मार्गम् Megh.i.21; 3. to betray, to reveal, to inform against, स जातु सेव्यमानोऽपि गुप्तद्वारो न सूच्यते R.xvii.50; 4. to indicate by gesture, to gesticulate, to communicate by signs, परिक्रम्य वामाक्षिस्पंदं सूचयित्वा Ve.iii.; 5. to trace out, to ascertain.With अभि-, to indicate, to suggest, e.g. अमन्यत नलं प्राप्तं कर्मचेष्टाभिसूचितम्.With सम्-, to indicate, to foreshadow, संयोगो हि वियोगस्य संसूचयति संभवम्.
शुच् f. Sorrow, grief, distress, प्रमदामनु संस्थितः शुचा नृपतिः सन्निति वाच्यदर्शनात् R.viii.72, मम विरहजां न त्वं वत्से शुचं गणयिष्यसि Sak.iv., R.xii.75.
सूच m. A pointed shoot or blade of kuśa grass.
सूचा f. 1. Piercing; 2. making signs, gesticulation; 3. spying out, seeing, sight.

शुचि (I) a. 1. Bright, resplendent; 2. white; 3. clear, विकचवारिरुहं दधतं सरः सकलहंसगणं शुचि मानसम् Kir.v.13; 4. holy, unsullied, undefiled, virtuous, शिवमगात्मजया च कृतेर्ष्यया सकलहं सगणं शुचिमानसम् Kir.v.13; 5. purified, R.i.81; 6. correct, faithful, true; 7. gentle, guileless.

शुचि (II) m. 1. The white colour; 2. purification; 3. virtue, goodness; 4. correctness; 5. the condition of a religious student; 6. a faithful friend or counsellor; 7. a Brāhmaṇa; 8. the hot season (ग्रीष्म), शुचौ चतुर्णां ज्वलतां हविर्भुजाम् K.S.v.20, शुचिव्यपाये वनराजिपल्वलम् R.iii.3; 9. the month of Āshāḍha; 10. fire; 11. the sun; 12. the moon; 13. the planet Venus; 14. the sentiment of love.

सूचि f. 1. Piercing, perforating; 2. a needle; 3. the pointed blade of kuśa grass, तैलं न्यषिच्यत मुखे कुशसूचिविद्धे Sak.iv.; 4. the sharp point of anything, कः करं प्रसारयेत् पन्नगरत्नसूचये K.S.v.43; 5. the point of a bud; 6. a kind of military array, a sharp file, दंडव्यूहेन तन्मार्गं यायातु शकटेन वा । वराहमकराभ्यां वा सूच्या वा गरुडेन वा M.vii.187; 7. a triangle formed by the sides of a trapezium produced till they meet; 8. a cone, a pyramid; 9. indication by gesture, gesticulation; 10. a particular mode of dancing; 11. dramatic action; 12. an index, a table of contents, a catalogue; 13. the earth’s disc in computing eclipses (in astronomy).
सूची f. The same as सूचि q.v.
शुचि-द्रुम m. the sacred fig tree.
शुचि-मणि m. crystal.
शुचि-मल्लिका f. a kind of jasmine.
शुचि-रोचिस् m. the moon.
शुचि-व्रत a. holy, pious, virtuous.
शुचि-स्मित a. having a sweet smile, K.S.v.20.
शुचिस् n. Light, lustre.
शुच्य् vt. or vi. 1P (pres. शुच्यति) 1. To bathe; 2. to distil; 3. to churn; 4. to press, to squeeze.
सुचक्षुस् (I) a. Having good eyes, seeing well.
सुचक्षुस् (II) m. 1. A discerning or wise man; 2. the glomerous fig tree.
सुचरित n. Good conduct, meritorious deeds, तव सुचरितमंगुलीय नूनम् Sak.vi.
सुचरित्रा f. A devoted and virtuous wife.
सुचित्रक m. 1. A king-fisher; 2. a kind of peckled snake.
सुचित्रा f. A kind of gourd.
सुचिंता f. Deep thought, deep reflection or consideration.
सुचिरम् ind. For a very long time.
सुचिरायुस् m. A god, a deity.
सूचक (I) a. (f. चिका) 1. Indicative, indicating, proving; 2. betraying, informing.

सूचक (II) m. 1. A piercer; 2. a needle, any instrument for perforating; 3. an informer, a tale bearer, a traduccr, a spy; 4. a narrator, a teacher, an instructor; 5. the manager or chief actor of a company; 6. a siddha; 7. a villain, a scoundrel; 8. a demon, an imp; 9. a dog; 10. a crow; 11. a cat; 12. a kind of fine rice.
सूचक (I) a. (f. चिका) 1. Indicative, indicating, proving; 2. betraying, informing.
सूचिका f. 1. A needle; 2. an elephant’s trunk.
सूचिक m. A tailor.
सूचक-वाक्य n. the information given by an informer.

सूचन n. 1. The act of piercing or perforating, perforation; 2. pointing out, indication, intimation; 3. informing against, betraying, traducing; 4. gesticulation, indicating by gesture; 5. hinting, hint; 6. information in general; 7. teaching, showing, describing; 8. spying out, espying, seeing; 9. wickedness.

सूचना f. 1. The act of piercing or perforating, perforation; 2. pointing out, indication, intimation; 3. informing against, betraying, traducing; 4. gesticulation, indicating by gesture; 5. hinting, hint; 6. information in general; 7. teaching, showing, describing; 8. spying out, espying, seeing; 9. wickedness.
सूचि-अग्र (I) a. needle-pointed, acuminated.
सूचि-अग्र (II) n. the point of a needle.
सूचि-अग्र˚स्थूलक m. a sort of grass.
सूचि-कटाहन्याय m. the maxim of the needle and the boiler. it is used to denote that, when two matters (one easy and another difficult) require attention, the simple one should be despatched first.
सूचि-खात m. a sharp pyramid or pyramidal excavation.
सूचि-ता f. needlework.
सूचित a. (f. ता) 1. Pierced, perforated; 2. pointed out, indicated, hinted; 3. made known or indicated by signs; 4. communicated, told, revealed; 5. ascertained, known.
सूचित a. (f. ता) 1. Pierced, perforated; 2. pointed out, indicated, hinted; 3. made known or indicated by signs; 4. communicated, told, revealed; 5. ascertained, known.
सूचि-पत्रक (I) n. a paper of contents.
सूचि-पत्रक (II) m. a kind of herb.
सूचि-पुष्प m. the ketaka tree.
सूचि-भिन्न a. divided into needles, bursting open at the points of the buds, पांडुच्छायोपवनवृत्तयः केतकैः सूचिभिन्नैः Megh.i.23.
सूचि-भेद्य a. 1. to be pierced or penetrated by a needle; 2. gross, thick, dense, रुद्धालोके नरपतिपथे सूचिभेद्यैस्तमोभिः Megh.i.37; 3. palpable, tangible.
सूचि-मुख (I) ??? needle-mouthed, having a pointed beak, pointed.
सूचि-मुख (II) m. 1. a bird; 2. the white kuśa grass; 3. a particular position of the hands.
सूचि-मुख (III) n. a diamond.
सूचि-रोमन् m. a hog.
सूचि-वदन (I) a. needle-faced, having a pointed beak.
सूचि-वदन (II) m. 1. an ichneumon; 2. a mosquito, a gnat.
सूचि-शालि m. a kind of rice.
सूचिका-मुख (I) a. having a pointed mouth or head.
सूचिका-मुख (II) n. a shell, the conch shell.
सूचिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Piercing, perforating; 2. pointing, indicating; 3. informing against; 4. spying out.
सूचिन् (II) m. A spy, an informer.
सूचिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Piercing, perforating; 2. pointing, indicating; 3. informing against; 4. spying out.
सूचिनी f. 1. A needle; 2. night.
सूच्य a. (f. च्या) Communicable.
सूच्य a. (f. च्या) Communicable.
